title: Preflight: customer ops & deployment notes (Marigold Systems)
content:
Quick context:
Customer: Marigold Systems (regulated-fintech pilot)
Deployment type: VPC + customer-hosted gateway (on-prem edge box)
Current phase: preflight -> first customer acceptance test (CAT) planned next Tue
Goal for this doc: prep notes for weekly ops sync (Thu) + checklist I can bring to 1:1s & escalate items from. Keep lightweight, action-focused.

Attendees (target):
- Marigold: Alex Rivera (SRE), Priya Menon (Network), CTO (TBD)
- Redwood: Noah (eng-private-deploy), Rita (solutions), Samir (infra), Evelyn (security eng)

Meeting objectives (top 3):
1) Confirm network connectivity windows and IP allowlist finalization
2) Lock cert provisioning/rotation process and KMS access scope
3) Triage remaining blockers for CAT and assign owners + dates

Agenda (30–40m):
- 0–5m: Quick status + shifts since last week (RAG summary)
- 5–15m: Network & routing (Priya) — IPs, NAT, egress policy, NTP
- 15–22m: Identity & secrets (Evelyn) — KMS/HSM, service accounts, cert timeline
- 22–30m: On-prem edge box readiness (Samir) — agent install, telemetry, firewall rules
- 30–35m: CAT plan & acceptance criteria review (Rita)
- 35–40m: Action items, owners, dates, next sync cadence

RAG snapshot (my read):
- Network: AMBER — allowlist mostly ready, waiting for Marigold IP blocks confirmation (Priya action)
- Certs/KMS: AMBER — cert CSR flow reviewed; Marigold needs to grant KMS read-role for rollout job (Evelyn coordinating)
- Edge agent: GREEN -> package test passed in staging; customer needs local service account to run systemd unit
- Data egress controls: RED -> policy doc outstanding; legal flagged a dataflow question (Alex follow-up)

Top blockers (to call out early):
1) Missing Marigold IP blocks for production scope — blocks allowlist update and NAT mapping. Owner: Priya Menon. Ask for final list by Mon EOD or escalate to CTO. If not provided, schedule a 30-min slot Mon to capture.
2) KMS role scoping — Marigold security wants minimal privileges; our rollout job requires kms:Decrypt for bootstrap token. Owner: Evelyn. Proposed mitigation: ephemeral delegation token + audit log hooks. Need decision by Tue.
3) Data retention policy confirmation — legal needs concrete matrix of what telemetry we collect, retention windows, and access controls. Owner: Alex Rivera (customer) + Rita to help craft draft doc. Deadline: Wed COB.

Preflight checklist (items I will verify in sync):
- [ ] IP allowlist file received and matched to infra (DoD: CSV + CIDR labels)
- [ ] Customer firewall window confirmed (date/time + rollback window)
- [ ] KMS role granted to rollout service principal OR agreed alternative flow
- [ ] Edge box has required ports open: 443 outbound, 2200 (SSH bastion) blocked unless scheduled
- [ ] Agent package version pinned (v1.4.2) and checksum verified
- [ ] Smoke tests defined (connectivity, auth, simple generate request, metrics shipping)
- [ ] CAT acceptance criteria doc linked in Confluence and shared with customer
- [ ] Incident comms channel established (Slack invite sent to marigold_ops)

Smoke test matrix (short):
- connectivity: API endpoint from edge -> host (pass if 200 within 150ms)
- auth: token exchange via KMS (pass if decrypted token available and request succeeds)
- inference sanity: run minimal prompt -> check response length and latency (pass if <500ms for 16-token answer)
- telemetry: verify metrics appear in our Prometheus namespace within 30s
- logs: agent logs shipped to S3-like storage for 24h retention (pass if log objects visible)

Runbook / rollback high-level (note to self):
- If CAT fails due to network: revert NAT rule change within maintenance window; re-route to staging (keep old route for 2 hours)
- If cert/KMS problem: fall back to short-lived delegated token for test traffic; escalate to infra on-call
- If agent causes CPU spike on edge: kill agent daemon, revert to collector-only mode, capture logs, reopen change window

Action items (post-meeting; concise):
- Priya: send final CIDR list + NAT mapping (due: Mon 2026-03-09 17:00)
- Evelyn: propose minimal KMS RBAC + ephemeral token flow doc (due: Tue 2026-03-10 noon)
- Rita: draft data telemetry matrix for legal review; include retention fields (due: Wed 2026-03-11 COB)
- Samir: push agent v1.4.2 package to customer staging repo; include sha256 (due: Mon 2026-03-09 EOD)
- Noah (me): update CAT checklist in Confluence, add test scenarios and expected pass thresholds (due: Mon 2026-03-09 12:00)

Notes-to-self / talking points for sync:
- Emphasize that allowlist is blocking our PROD cutover; ask explicitly for a single point of contact who can sign off IP changes
- Offer a 1-hour remote session for cert handoff if Marigold security needs it (Evelyn + Rita join)
- Keep the CAT narrow — aim for three core tests and one non-blocking add-on test to avoid scope creep

Risks I want on record (for CTO readout):
- If IP list slips beyond Mon EOD, PROD CAT will slip one week due to calendar constraints for firewall windows
- Unclear KMS scoping could require a minor code-path change in rollout job (2 dev days) if customer cannot grant decrypt permission

Meeting prep checklist (what I need to have open/take to call):
- Confluence CAT doc (linked)
- allowlist spreadsheet open and editable
- Slack threads: #marigold-ops, #infra-ansible
- Quick demo script for smoke test (local curl commands)

Follow-ups after sync (my follow-up plan):
- Immediately file short recap in Confluence + assign Jira tasks for any new blockers
- Ping customer SRE channel if allowlist not delivered by deadline; escalate to account exec if blocked 24h after deadline
- Schedule 30-min dry-run Thurs AM before CAT run on Tue

Random scratch notes (for later):
- check whether our agent can use OS-level certificate store vs bundled certs (reduces rotation ops)
- confirm NTP source for edge box to avoid drift during tests
- ask legal whether aggregated telemetry (no PII) still needs special handling for fintech use-case

End of doc. Keep lean. Will iterate after Thu sync and convert to a proper handoff doc if green across items.
